items.subject: Custom warp-level hierarchical reduction for large inputs
items.objective: Explore a hand-written high-throughput multi-CTA reduction for large n. Replace the repeated 128-thread reduction passes with coalesced loads, per-thread accumulation over multiple elements, and an efficient warp-level/block reduction. Search tile size and launch geometry to reduce partial count and total work; have a final device pass write the result directly to out. Do not rely on output initialization or atomics. Preserve exact int32 reduction semantics and validate all required sizes, including n=2^22.
